summary: Strawberry Fields REIT filed an 8-K/A to report the closing of a Corporate Credit Facility with Popular Bank. The facility consists of a $100M term loan and a $200M revolving line, both maturing June 18, 2029, with two one-year extensions. Interest is the greater of 1-month SOFR + 275 bps or 5.50%. Proceeds will refinance existing debt and support acquisitions and working capital. No change of control, tender offer, or special situation is involved. This is a routine financing entry.
